headline: Is Carnival (CCL) Below Fair Value Even After A 64% Run?
summary: Carnival stock has delivered a 63.8% gain over the past three years, yet the latest Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate still points to meaningful upside at the current US$27.81 share price. At the same time, recent news on cruise demand and costs is keeping attention on whether that apparent discount is justified. Carnival has returned 63.8% over the last three years, which puts more focus on whether the current valuation still leaves room for further gains. Strong Caribbean...
